text: Ko wano Men jippinirnoo Defte ɗen non e ɓen adi- adinooɓe ma, Men jippiniri Alqur'aana e maaɗa. Yoga e ɓee janngooɓe Tawreeta, wano ‘AbduLlaah ibn Salaam, hino gomɗiniri nde sabu ko nde joopa joopaa fii mun kon ka defte maɓɓe. Yeddataa Aayeeje Amen ɗen, si wanaa heeferɓe ɓen woowuɓe yeddugol goonga ko o feeñi woo.
